summary: 19% by mass) and sulfate anions SO42−. It is a white crystalline solid, soluble in water.

uses.text: Magnesium sulfate is used both externally as bath salts, especially for foot baths to soothe sore feet, and internally as a replacement therapy for magnesium deficiency. It is commonly used in hospital settings to treat abnormal blood levels of magnesium as an electrolyte and for constipation.
